full_chain_findings: Concrete registered CROW is CREATURE with factory EntityCrow; constructor installs item target plus crop-foraging and frame-deposit goals. Crop goal uses config crowsStealCrops default true and actual config-holder assignment; current deployed config and tag contents are unproved. Goal entry excludes babies/tame/active live attack/aiItemFlag/pumpkin flee; continuation repeats these except baby. Native MOVE/JUMP scheduling and item-goal concurrency prevent interpreting source loop as an uninterrupted wall-clock duration.

Crop circle phase clears tryTicks and lasts through >200 updates, then approach/peck service uses horizontal distance and cumulative idleAtFlowerTime until stop. Six reached updates lead to destroyCrop. Positive CropBlock age is decremented by unchecked setBlockAndUpdate; age0 or nonCrop destroys with drops requested when RULE_MOBGRIEFING true. No immediate produce insertion into crow is present. Native Level.destroyBlock drops resources before setBlock and returns write result, which this goal ignores. Exact tags, Forge policy outcomes, actual loot and player receipt are absent. Both destroyCrop branches set tryTicks1200 after own stop, but normal caller immediately calls stop again resetting tryTicks0; separate inherited nextStartTick remains, so this is not evidence of zero cooldown.

Dropped-item callback copies one stack into hand, drops old cargo on server without admission acknowledgment and assigns seedThrowerID only for an untamed tagged stack with ItemEntity.getOwner nonnull. Native ItemEntity.getOwner resolves thrower UUID in ServerLevel, while pickup target UUID is separately setTarget: this is not automatically a player or pickup ownership. Earlier complete CreatureAITargetItems/ITargetsDroppedItems actual reads show callback-before-sourceStack.shrink1, so the callback alone is not payment acknowledgment.

Held nonempty increments heldItemTime; >60 and edible and wild-or-injured causes heal4/EAT feedback and actual hand shrink after possible container remainder spawn. Pending seedThrowerID plus tagged seed and !tame has30percent random tame attempt, sets command1 and ownerUUID; ServerPlayer criterion only if UUID resolves player. Eating/taming own branch lacks a server-side guard; no runtime ownership/sync success is asserted. Replacing one nonempty hand with another does not reset held time at callback, and pending UUID is not own-saved. Whole class defines food as edible item or tag, breed food as tame-and-tagged.

Interaction invokes parent first; held-cargo release on parent result!=SUCCESS has no owner guard, drops unchecked and clears hand. Owner-only command branch optionally takes one edible item without creative exception, cycles raw command with wrap only at4, sets custom sitting on command2. Fallback calls parent again; no blanket one-parent-call or one-charge guarantee. Native Animal successful adult/baby breeding has its own state/payment conditions, so no unconditional double-consumption claim. Native TamableAnimal does not override mobInteract.

Crow overrides setOrderedToSit to only its Synched SITTING; it does not update TamableAnimal private orderedToSit. Native SitWhenOrderedToGoal reads isOrderedToSit/private parent field and writes parent sitting-pose, whereas crow movement and deposit gates use its isSitting. Parent NBT saves/restores Sitting and Owner, and crow independently saves MonkeySitting: these are distinct state channels, not proof command2 updates every native sitting goal or exact visual pose.

Command3/nonempty cargo/deposit canUse rejects passenger/vehicle/sitting/aiItemFlag and applies worldTime/mod10/noAction/random scan gate. Item frames are scanned in AABB inflated16, despite getTargetDistance4; frame predicate tests inventory capability on opposite facing behind the frame and ItemStack.isSameItem only item type, not NBT/cap compatibility/count. Native isSameItemSameTags is a separate helper not used. Goal sets aiItemFrameFlag on successful canUse and stop clears it. Continuation only checks targetnonnull/command3/nonempty hand, no repeated owner/tame/sameitem/framealive/sit/aiitem validation.

Near-frame execute queries capability behind same frame but with front-facing side, different from selection. Simulated remainder is compared using Object equals to duplicate; neither ItemStack nor CapabilityProvider declares equals override, and provider extends Object. IItemHandler contract allows unchanged remainder as same or new stack. Therefore identity difference can cause a real execute attempt even with unchanged content; no capacity delta is established by the condition. ItemHandlerHelper returns remainder by traversing slots; real return is put back into crow hand or clears it, and peck follows. Handler exceptions are swallowed and near attempt always stops; no rollback/transaction/native inventory readback/player UUID receipt is shown. cooldown20 only on equal simulation and decrements only active ticks; no whole native container implementation was read.

Every tamed checkPerchCooldown0 first sets50 then optional home-tag heal/67/perch set; subsequent same-tick command3-and-cooldown0 cleanup branch is unreachable under the shown normal sequential state, so no proven perch validation/fallback. Own NBT saves Flying/MonkeySitting/Command and conditional XYZ; missing XYZ leaves old perch on existing object but new object starts null. Parent Owner/HandItems persistence is separate reused native support. seedThrowerID, held-time, ai flags/deposit target/cooldown are not own-saved; fresh reconstruction differs from in-place NBT read. Hurt success or interaction may drop cargo unchecked, not a player delivery acknowledgment.
